ERREUR_INTERNE: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again shortly.
CONFLIT_UNICITE: Someone else has just made the same change. Please reload the page.
ACCES_REFUSE: You do not have permission for this action.
HTTPS_EXIGE: The server accepts HTTPS only: use the https:// address.
CONFLIT_VERSION: This item was changed by {by} {when}. Reload?
VERSION_REQUISE: The version of the item read is required to change it (If-Match header). Please reload the page.
TEXTE_HTML_INTERDIT: The field {field} cannot contain HTML tags.
VALEUR_INVALIDE: The value of {field} is not valid.
PROJET_CODE_INVALIDE: The project code must be 3 to 6 capital letters.
PROJET_CODE_EXISTANT: The project code {code} is already in use.
PROJET_CODE_CORBEILLE: The project code {code} belongs to a project in the recycle bin: restore it, or delete it permanently to free the code.
PROJET_SANS_ANIMATEUR: A project must keep at least one facilitator.
CONFIRMATION_INVALIDE: To confirm, type the project code exactly ({code}).
COULOIR_DERNIER: A map must keep at least one lane.
TRADUCTIONS_INVALIDES: The file contains rejected translations: nothing was saved.
CONFLIT_INTEGRITE: The map has changed in the meantime: the action was not done. Reload the map.
COULOIR_SUPPRIME: This lane has just been deleted. Reload the map?
ETAPE_SANS_CONTENU: A start, an end or a gateway has no sheet and no RACI.
COULOIR_NON_VIDE: This lane contains steps: choose to move or delete them.
COULOIR_CIBLE_INVALIDE: The destination lane must be another lane of the same map.
ORDRE_COULOIRS_INVALIDE: The list must contain each lane of the map exactly once.
DISPOSITION_CASE_OCCUPEE: Two steps cannot occupy the same cell.
ETAPE_HORS_CARTE: Step {code} is not on this map.
ETAPE_DEJA_DETAILLEE: This step already has its own map.
ETAPE_NON_DETAILLABLE: A start, an end or a gateway cannot be broken down.
MACRO_CHOIX_REQUIS: This step has its own map: choose to delete it or attach it to another step.
RATTACHEMENT_INVALIDE: The map cannot be attached to this step.
TRANSFERT_HORS_PROJET: Steps cut in another project cannot be pasted here: use Copy.
TRANSFERT_CYCLE: A step cannot be pasted into its own detailed map.
CARTE_RACINE: A project's root map cannot be deleted.
LIEN_REFLEXIF: A step cannot be linked to itself.
LIEN_DOUBLON: These two steps are already linked in this direction.
LIEN_HORS_CARTE: Both steps of a link must be on the same map.
COMMANDE_VIDE: Type a command, for example VTE-E012 > VTE-E013.
COMMANDE_SYNTAXE: Line {line}: expected syntax CODE1 > CODE2 or CODE1 > CODE2 : label.
COMMANDE_ERREURS: The command was not applied, please fix the reported lines.
FICHIER_INVALIDE: The file could not be opened: {count} problem(s) to fix.
FICHIER_SANS_FEUILLE_PROJET: The workbook has no project sheet: it is not a translation workbook exported by the application.
FICHE_VIDE: The description is empty: write at least one answer before confirming it.
FICHE_ETAT_INVALIDE: Clarification can only be requested on a confirmed description.
ADRESSE_INVALIDE: The link must be a web address http(s):// (OneDrive, SharePoint) or a file path (\\server\folder or X:\folder).
DETAIL_ABSENT: This step has no detail to bring back up.
REMONTEE_EN_COURS: A detail brought back up is still waiting for its documents to be distributed on this map: finish its frame first.
REMONTEE_EN_COURS_DESSOUS: A detail further down is still waiting for its documents to be distributed: finish its frame first.
USAGE_EXISTANT: This step already receives this document (or produces it).
DOCUMENT_UTILISE_PAR_CIBLE: This step uses this document: it cannot also produce it. Choose the step that makes it.
FREQUENCES_MELANGEES: This detail has a different frequency from the flow it would join: two flows that were separated would be mixed again.
CARTE_MODIFIEE: The map has changed since: this action can no longer be undone. The history of the map starts again from scratch.
OPERATION_DEPASSEE: This action can no longer be undone: {by} changed the map {when}. The history of the map starts again from scratch.
PAQUET_INVALIDE: The package is invalid or damaged ({reason}): nothing was imported.
PAQUET_TROP_RECENT: This package comes from a more recent version of the application (format {version}): update the application to import it.
PROPOSITION_NOUVEAU_PROJET: This proposal brings steps up a level or moves them to another level: it opens as a new project, and the original map stays as it is.
PMAP_JSON: The content is not valid JSON (line {line}, column {column}).
PMAP_PAS_OBJET: The file must contain a JSON object.
PMAP_FORMAT: This is not a map file of the application: "format" must be "{expected}".
PMAP_VERSION: Version {version} is not supported: the application reads version {supported}.
PMAP_TYPE_TEXTE: "{name}" must be a text in quotes.
PMAP_TROP_ETAPES: The file has {count} steps: {max} at most.
PMAP_CARTE_SANS_COULOIR: A map has at least one lane.
PMAP_COULOIR_FORME: A lane is an object with "id" and "name".
PMAP_ETAPE_FORME: A step is an object with "id", "lane" and "label".
PMAP_LIEN_FORME: A link is an object with "source" and "target".
PMAP_ID_INVALIDE: Invalid id "{id}": 1 to {max} characters, without leading or trailing spaces.
PMAP_ID_DOUBLON: Id "{id}" is already used in the file: each lane, each step and each document has its own.
PMAP_COULOIR_INCONNU: Lane "{lane}" does not exist in this map.
PMAP_COLONNE: "column" is an integer from 0 to {max} (0 = first column).
PMAP_RANGEE: "row" is an integer from 0 to {max} (0 = first row of the lane; parallel branches of the same actor go below).
PMAP_COLONNES_PARTIELLES: "column" is given for some steps only: give it for all of them or for none (automatic layout).
PMAP_CASE_DOUBLE: Two steps occupy the same cell (lane {lane}, column {column}): {steps}.
PMAP_SOUS_CARTE_SANS_CONTENU: A start, an end or an AND or inclusive OR gateway cannot be broken down: remove "sub_map" or change the type.
PMAP_PROFONDEUR: Too many levels of sub-maps: {max} at most.
PMAP_RACI_FORME: "raci" maps the id of a lane of the map to a letter, for example "c2": "A".
PMAP_RACI_R_AILLEURS: R is the step's own lane ({own}): for "{lane}", choose from {letters}, or place the step in that lane.
PMAP_RACI_ROLE: Invalid role "{role}" for lane {lane}: {letters} (R is the step's own lane).
PMAP_RACI_PROPRE_COULOIR: The step's own lane ({lane}) performs it (R): it cannot receive another role.
PMAP_RACI_TYPE: A start, an end or an AND or inclusive OR gateway has no RACI: remove "raci" or change the type.
PMAP_LIEN_REFLEXIF: A step cannot be linked to itself ({step}).
PMAP_ETAPE_AUTRE_CARTE: Step "{step}" is in another map: a link connects two steps of the same map.
PMAP_ETAPE_INCONNUE: Step "{step}" does not exist in this map.
PMAP_FICHE_FORME: This element of the sheet must be an object.
PMAP_FICHE_TYPE: A start, an end or an AND or inclusive OR gateway has no sheet: remove "sheet" or change the type.
PMAP_SORTIE_INCONNUE: Document "{document}" is not an output of another step of this map.
PMAP_USAGE_DOUBLON: Output "{document}" is used twice by this step.
IA_INDISPONIBLE: No AI is configured to be called from the application: the panel works by copy and paste.
IA_CLASSIFICATION_REFUSEE: The classification of this project does not allow sending it to the AI: this is a setting of the administrator.
IA_CONTENU_TROP_GRAND: The content to send to the AI exceeds the limit of {max} characters: shorten the request or the history of the panel.
IA_FICHIERS_TROP_NOMBREUX: A conversation of the assistant holds {max} files at most: remove one, or start a new conversation.
IA_FICHIERS_TROP_LOURDS: The files of the conversation together exceed {max} MB: remove one, or start a new conversation.
IA_FICHIER_TROP_GROS: The file “{name}” exceeds {max} MB, the size the AI accepts for this kind of file.
IA_FICHIER_FORMAT: The file “{name}” is not of a kind the assistant reads: PDF, image (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP), Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx) or Visio (.vsdx).
IA_FICHIER_ANCIEN_FORMAT: The file “{name}” is in a former format of Office: save it in the {format} format, then join it again.
IA_FICHIER_ILLISIBLE: The file “{name}” cannot be read: it is empty, damaged, protected by a password, or its content is not what its name says.
IA_FICHIER_PROTEGE: The PDF “{name}” is protected by a password, which the AI refuses: join a copy without protection.
